[IARC.3.14.1] Owns `ds_schema_t` and the per-engine schema
registry. Validates and registers fact-type
declarations; resolves slot names, types, and unit
dimensions; is the authority `wm` and `dispatcher`
consult to type-check asserted facts and decoded RHS
args. Engine-lifetime once registered; freed on
registry destroy ([IARC.6.2]).
